name: Mac run and retire the C++ editor host
body:
Dean runs the Nox editor host on his Mac, then the C++ host goes: `apps/world-editor/src/main.cpp`, `EditorHost.cpp`, `src/native/` and the CMake project. The Nox host (`apps/world-editor/nox`) becomes the only way to run the editor. `src/ui` and `data/fonts` stay, since the Nox host loads them.

`engine/editor-backend`'s C API (`lantern_editor.h`) and its C test stay for now; nothing in the editor uses it after this, and whether to keep it is its own question.
